release.about: main is the integration branch and nothing deploys from it: production is a manual deploy (docs/build/deployment.md). Agents merge every tier into main on proof alone (decided 15 November 2026, applied here 21 November). Each pull request names its tier and its proof in its Verification section; no Merge Gate check reads it. CI's check job (bun run check, then bun run vercel-build) runs on every pull request and is the required check, so no change of any tier merges without the full gate and the production build passing.

critical.about: Keys, the timelock, the tally, attestations, the generator, sessions and every server write, the data, deploy, the dependency allowlists, the git guardrail and CI. Proof: bun run check and bun run vercel-build green on the head (CI's check job), plus an adversarial review by a fresh agent with its findings addressed, both recorded in the pull request's Verification section. Agents merge on that proof. Code-owner review is not required: GitHub refuses approval of one's own pull request.

sensitive.about: The shared contract (types, copy, constants, validators), the rest of the API and the Vercel routes, and the agent rules. Proof: bun run check green and an adversarial review by a fresh agent with its findings addressed, both recorded in the pull request's Verification section. Agents merge on that proof.

routine.about: Everything else. Proof: the targeted check for the changed behavior (the narrowest test or command that exercises it, as node scripts/select-checks.mjs prints) and CI green, recorded in the pull request's Verification section. A change that renders under packages/app/src adds captures at 375 and 1280 wide, or says why they are pending.
